data.one_liner: An animated text widget for Flutter that simulates a typing effect.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable animated text widget that simulates a character-by-character typing effect cycling between words. Users can control speeds and text styles through simple properties.
use_when: You need a typewriter or typing text effect in a chatbot or storytelling app.
You want to display dynamic text with visual flair easily.
avoid_when: You need complex complex motion graphics or physics-based animations not covered by standard text animation.
You require advanced non-text specific animations.
strengths: Easy to set up and use with a declarative widget API.
Customizable speed for typing and delays between words.
weaknesses: Limited to a single typing animation use case.
Not documented with extensive advanced configurations beyond basic parameters.
data.minimal_example:
TypingText(
  words: ['Hello', 'World'],
  letterSpeed: Duration(milliseconds: 100),
  wordSpeed: Duration(milliseconds: 1000),
  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 24, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
)
